_comment: Page copy for /g/uk-ai-visibility, written 6 Nov 2026 from the owner's decisions of that day: a retainer from £1,500 a month with £500 of ChatGPT ad spend included, month to month, 30 days' notice, a named contact and a monthly status report; no guarantee; UK companies with £1m or more in turnover. The case is C-Medical, named with its written consent. Figures: AI assistant bookings are booking_completed in the group's Google Analytics (property 419601371) by month, all AI sources, paid and unpaid together, because the ChatGPT ads carried no utm tags until 6 Nov 2026 and some ad clicks are therefore inside the count. The ad figures (NOK 10,000, 420 clicks, 12 bookings, the 30 days to 6 Nov 2026) are the owner's, from OpenAI's ads manager, at NOK 12.5148 to the pound. The two are shown side by side and never added. Market figures: Which?, December 2025 (Yonder, 4,189 UK adults, 10 to 14 Sept 2025); OpenAI's head of ChatGPT, February 2026; OpenAI Ads Manager open to UK advertisers from 22 June 2026. The build refuses dashes, exclamation marks and American spellings. Nothing here may describe commission.

how.intro: One package, run by one team, reported once a month. The ChatGPT ad spend is inside the price.

items.p: In the first month we track 25 questions your buyers ask across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google's AI answers, see who is named instead of you, and fix what stops AI tools reading your site.
Every month, four pages written to answer those questions, and work to get you named on the third-party sites AI tools trust: trade directories, industry press and review sites.
We set up and run your ChatGPT ads, with £500 a month of ad spend included, and track every enquiry they bring in.

fit.h2: For companies whose buyers research before they call.
fit.body: This works best where one new client is worth thousands and the buyer asks a lot of questions first: IT and technology, professional services, healthcare, property, finance and business services.

pay.h2: From £1,500 a month. Ad spend included.
pay.body: One price each month, with £500 of ChatGPT ad spend inside it. Nothing to pay up front and no long contract: the agreement runs month to month from the start, and you can stop with 30 days' notice.
open: From £1,500 a month, excluding VAT, with £500 of ChatGPT ad spend included. A larger scope is priced on the call, in writing, before anything runs.
Month to month from the first day. Give 30 days' notice by email to stop.
A named contact person at Elevate Marketing, who answers within one working day.
A status report every month: where you are named in AI answers and where you are not, what we published, what the ads cost and what they brought in.

items.p: ChatGPT ads run in an account in your company's name. If you stop, you keep it.
Every page we write is yours, on your site, approved by you before it goes live.
If a question still names a competitor after three months, the report says so, and what we will change.

meeting.body: We do not pitch. Before the call we put your buyers' questions to ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity and look at who they name.

steps.p: You tell us your website and the questions your best clients ask before they buy.
We show you what the AI tools answer today, who they name instead of you, and why.
You receive a one page summary: where you stand, the three changes that would matter most, and what the package would cost for you.

meeting.closing: You keep the summary whether or not we work together.

items.q: Is this just SEO with a new name?
items.a: Partly. AI assistants read the same web as Google, so a site that is easy to read and well referenced helps both. What is new is that an AI answer names a few companies instead of listing ten, leans heavily on third-party sources, and now carries ads. We work on all three.

items.q: How soon will we see anything?
items.a: ChatGPT ads can bring visits in the first week. Being named in unpaid AI answers usually takes two to four months of content and mentions, and depends on how strong your competitors are.
No. An AI answer changes from one person and one day to the next, so nobody can honestly promise a position. We track the same questions every month, so you can see whether it is working.

items.q: Your case is a Norwegian clinic group. Why would this work for us?
items.a: ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity give UK and Norwegian buyers the same kind of answer, built from the same kind of sources. What differs is competition and cost per click, and we go through both on the first call.
Yes, for the search work. OpenAI does not take ads for legal services in ChatGPT, so we agree the scope for a law firm on the call.

items.q: What if we want to stop?
items.a: Give 30 days' notice by email. You keep the content and the ad account.
